mirrorCaption: See and control the whole phone
allAppsCaption: Search every app on the phone
directBusy: Setting up… keep the phone unlocked
disconnectCaption: Close windows and drop the connection
connectCaption: Find your phone nearby or over Tailscale
pairCaption: Over Wi-Fi with a QR code
soundPcTip: Sound plays on this computer. Click to play it on the phone (S)
soundPhoneTip: Sound plays on the phone. Click to play it on this computer (S)
soundPcNextTip: Opens with its sound on this computer. Click to use the phone (S)
soundPhoneNextTip: Opens with its sound on the phone. Click to use this computer (S)
networkMapCaption: How this computer reaches your phone
routerLine: Router %1, which hands out the Wi-Fi addresses.
differentAp: the phone and this computer use different access points
whereUsb: Over the cable, by the phone's serial number. No addresses involved.
whereUsbOff: Plug the phone in for the fastest connection.
whereDirect: The phone runs this Wi-Fi Direct link and always takes 192.168.49.1. It gave this computer %1.
whereDirectChannel: It's on another channel than your Wi-Fi, so phonelink prefers the router.
whereDirectUnsupported: Needs NetworkManager with wpa_supplicant and a Wi-Fi card that can do Wi-Fi Direct.
whereDirectOff: Set up when a window opens over Wi-Fi.
whereWifiMdns: The phone announced its debugging port over mDNS.
whereWifiTcpip: Set up with phonelink wifi over USB.
whereWifiOff: The phone isn't on this computer's network.
whereTailscaleLearned: phonelink noted the phone's while it was nearby, and checked it against your tailnet.
whereTailscaleSetting: Set by TAILSCALE_HOST in your phonelink config.
whereTailscaleOnly: It's the only Android device on your tailnet.
whereTailscaleOff: Tailscale isn't set up for this phone.
tailscaleOffline: The phone is offline on Tailscale.
tailscaleDirect: Traffic takes a direct path, through %1.
tailscaleRelayed: Traffic is relayed through Tailscale's %1 server.
portMdns: The debugging port came from the phone's mDNS announcement. It changes whenever Wireless debugging is turned on.
portTcpip: The debugging port is 5555, opened with phonelink wifi until the phone restarts.
portRemembered: The debugging port is the one phonelink last saw.
mobileData: The phone is also on mobile data (%1, from its carrier), which isn't reachable from here.
